name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1921: notFound has been a bare set of names since it was written - no reel, no frame, no lane, no moment - so when the same piece is read found on one page and not found on another, which happens constantly because he keeps finding things, nothing could say which photographs disagreed and nothing computed that they disagreed at all. It cost a wrong answer to him directly: told that twelve of his thirty-six proposed set pieces were ones the game says he does not have, three of them carry First Found dates on his newest reel and the not-found readings were simply old. Measured over his banked evidence there are 26 contested names, thirteen of each ledger, including the very item he told me he does not have. Each not-found reading now carries its page and eye beside the untouched original field, the contradiction is computed and merged and printed, and it is deliberately made visible rather than resolved because the ordering to resolve it is not stored.
